clue.text: Shelter for a year in squalid area

indicators.note: the article and the year's abbreviation are placed inside the word for a squalid area

parts.note: a slum is a squalid run-down district

explanation.surface: Someone takes refuge for a year in a run-down neighbourhood.
explanation.definitionFit: Asylum is refuge or protection given to someone fleeing danger.

clue.text: Philosopher, one hosted by drunken Scot

indicators.note: one piece is a guest inside another, so it sits within the jumbled letters
drunken letters reel about, so the word Scot is rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A philosopher is entertained by an inebriated Scotsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunken' rearranges SCOT to STOC, and 'hosted by' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stoic was a follower of Zeno's school of thought in ancient Greece.

clue.text: Painstaking European article on Oxford University, penned by a Russian

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for 'the'

indicators.note: something penned by another is enclosed within it, so the university goes inside the Russian name

parts.note: Boris is a typical Russian first name

explanation.surface: A Russian writes a careful European article about Oxford University.
explanation.definitionFit: Laborious work is careful and demanding of great effort.

clue.text: Doctor put on coat made from expensive material

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor in the forces
an animal's coat is its hair

explanation.surface: A doctor puts on a costly coat.
explanation.definitionFit: Mohair is a luxurious fabric woven from the hair of the Angora goat.

clue.text: Final appearance, now snag's ironed out

indicators.note: a snag ironed out is smoothed and reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A last performance can happen now that the problem has been resolved.
explanation.definitionFit: A swan song is a farewell performance, from the legend that swans sing before dying.

clue.text: Unresponsive to psychiatric treatment?

parts.note: a shrink is slang for a psychiatrist, so a patient who resists one is literally this; the usual sense is fabric that will not contract in the wash

explanation.surface: A patient who cannot be helped by therapy.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing that will not get smaller when washed is described with this term, read here as resisting a psychiatrist.

clue.text: Clever, concealing change of name, but likely to co-operate

indicators.note: one word hides another inside it, so the clever word wraps the altered letters

parts.note: able means clever or capable

indicators.note: a change of the word name means its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone smart who hides a new identity yet seems compliant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change of' turns NAME into MENA, and 'concealing' puts it inside ABLE after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An amenable person is willing to agree and easy to persuade.

clue.text: Fight over in Cottesmore

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the letters are turned back to front
the letters sit inside the place name Cottesmore

explanation.surface: A brawl has ended in a Rutland village.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' finds OTTES inside Cottesmore, a village in Rutland, and 'over' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A set-to is a brief scrap or heated argument.

clue.text: So unfair, being beastly about English — it's vicious

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go about, that is around, the letter for English
beastly treatment mangles the words so unfair into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone complains that it is cruel to be so harsh towards the English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beastly' rearranges SO UNFAIR, and 'about' puts it around E.
explanation.definitionFit: Nefarious means wicked or villainous, close to vicious.

clue.text: May Day dancer's obsession

definitions.meaning: a figure in a horse costume dances in traditional English May Day and morris celebrations
a pet subject someone keeps returning to

explanation.definitionFit: The costumed horse figure appears in English folk festivities, and the phrase also means a favourite fixation someone talks about constantly.

clue.text: Dog Mum's abandoned leads to quarrel

indicators.note: the mothers' word is left behind, so it is taken out of the dog breed

parts.note: a mastiff is a large dog breed
mas is a plural of ma, a word for mum, read as Mum's

explanation.surface: A dog's mother walks off, and that leads to a row.
explanation.walkthrough: MAS ('Mum's', read as mas) comes off the front of MASTIFF, and 'abandoned' signals that removal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a minor squabble, especially between people close to each other.

clue.text: Sign given by corporation in Jerusalem

indicators.note: the abbreviated corporation is placed inside the name for Jerusalem

parts.note: Sion (Zion) is a name for Jerusalem
corp is the abbreviation for corporation

explanation.surface: A notice put up by a company in the Holy City.
explanation.definitionFit: Scorpio, the Scorpion, is one of the twelve zodiac signs.

clue.text: A way to convey a large reptile in a vessel?

indicators.note: to convey something is to carry it, so the reptile is held within the other letters

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
a boa is a large constricting snake

explanation.surface: How to transport a big snake by boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to convey' puts BOA inside A and RD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being aboard means being on a ship or other craft.

clue.text: Fragrant essence obtained from natural fibre when peeled

indicators.note: peeling strips the outside, so the first and last letters of the fibre go

parts.note: cotton is a natural plant fibre

explanation.surface: A perfume extracted from plant fibre once the skin is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto, or attar, is an oil distilled from flowers, especially roses.

clue.text: Somehow natural in Army to get predatory type?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go in the abbreviation for the army reserve

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters of natural are arranged some other way

explanation.surface: It is somehow natural for an army to produce a hunter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' rearranges NATURAL into ARANTUL, and 'in' puts it inside TA.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarantula is a large hairy spider that hunts its prey.

clue.text: Correspondence from great-niece, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a connection or link between two things
an example of a family member

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a link between things and also a kinsman, of which a great-niece is one example.

clue.text: Carrier enabling fighters to land

parts.note: suggests an aircraft carrier with a deck for warplanes, but it is a vessel ferrying soldiers to shore

explanation.surface: An aircraft carrier where warplanes touch down.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of vessel transports soldiers to their destination.

clue.text: Write us a song about drinking

indicators.note: the song goes about, that is around, the two short words

parts.note: a carol is a song, especially a festive one
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A request to compose a tune about boozing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts US and A inside CAROL; 'Write' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A carousal is a noisy session of heavy drinking and merrymaking.

clue.text: Very French, to disregard sin?

parts.note: tres is French for very
to pass on something is to let it go or ignore it

explanation.surface: Asking whether ignoring things is a terribly French sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Trespass is an old word for wrongdoing, as in the Lord's Prayer.

clue.text: Get rid of books about America

indicators.note: the books go about, that is around, the abbreviation for America

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books

explanation.surface: Banning books about the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: To oust is to expel or drive out.

clue.text: Market restriction applied to South Africa after start of apartheid.

indicators.note: the restriction is wrapped around the other letters, applied over them

parts.note: a bar is a restriction or ban

indicators.note: the abbreviation for the country comes after the first letter
the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: ZA is South Africa's international code

explanation.surface: Trade sanctions imposed on South Africa once apartheid began.
explanation.walkthrough: A (from 'start of apartheid') with ZA after it makes AZA, which goes inside BAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A bazaar is a marketplace, especially an Eastern one.

clue.text: One of the dark blues with a regular place in the bow?

definitions.text: One of the dark blues with a regular place in the bow?

parts.words: One of the dark blues with a regular place in the bow?
parts.note: suggests an Oxford rower sitting in the bow seat, but means a deep blue colour that always appears in the rainbow

explanation.surface: An Oxford rower who always sits at the front of the boat.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dark Blues are Oxford's crew in the Boat Race; the bow is really a rainbow.
explanation.definitionFit: This deep blue-violet is one of the seven colours of the rainbow.

clue.text: Norwegian pen nibs enclosed, considerably reduced

indicators.note: both words are cut down a lot, leaving only the run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Norwegian pen nibs come in a box, heavily discounted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'considerably reduced' leaves IBSEN inside the run 'nibs enclosed'; 'pen' means writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Henrik Ibsen was the great Norwegian playwright, a writer.

clue.text: Stock running lower and lower and lower…

definitions.text: Stock running lower and lower and lower…

parts.words: Stock running lower and lower and lower…
parts.note: suggests share prices falling, but means cattle running while mooing repeatedly

explanation.surface: Share prices falling further and further.
explanation.walkthrough: To low is to moo, so 'lower' is a lowing cow and 'stock' is livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: A stampede is a panicked rush of cattle or horses.

clue.text: Hand baby may have put in mouth

definitions.meaning: in bridge, the declarer's partner's cards laid face up on the table

definitions.text: baby may have put in mouth
definitions.meaning: a rubber teat given to an infant to suck

explanation.definitionFit: In bridge it is the exposed hand of cards, and a pacifier is the same word.

clue.text: Stays in hospital

definitions.meaning: ropes that steady a tent or mast
... is a famous teaching hospital in London

explanation.definitionFit: Ropes bracing a tent or mast have this name, and Guy's is a well-known London hospital.

clue.text: He'll usually remain unmoved

parts.note: suggests a stoic person who is not emotionally affected, but means someone who rarely leaves the house

explanation.surface: Describing a calm person who is rarely stirred.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a person prefers to stay in rather than go out.

clue.text: Glove Dad's sister left in bag

indicators.note: the relative and the letter go in the word for bag

parts.note: to bag something is to get it
a father's sister is an aunt

explanation.surface: Dad's sister has left a glove in a handbag.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauntlet is a heavy glove with a long wide cuff.

clue.text: Reimburses agents, having accepted agreement

indicators.note: the agents take in the other piece, so it sits inside

parts.note: reps are sales representatives, agents
ay, or aye, is a word of agreement

explanation.surface: A firm pays back its representatives after they agreed a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To repay is to pay back money owed.
